title: Seasonal Cedar
summary: Celebrate the season with a hands-on holiday experience! Join the Whitchurch-Stouffville Museum and Toronto and Region Conservation Authority for a cozy morning of crafting and heritage.
description: Celebrate the season with a hands-on holiday experience! Join the Whitchurch-Stouffville Museum and Toronto and Region Conservation Authority for a cozy morning of crafting and heritage. Enjoy a guided tour through the Museum’s historic buildings, beautifully decorated for the holidays, then learn about native cedar species as you create your own eco-friendly ornament with step-by-step instruction. Registration includes one cedar ornament, a guided holiday tour, and light seasonal refreshments. Ornament is approximately 7″ in size. Customization plates and other decorative add-ons will be available.
